Avatar.purpose: Show a profile photo, initials, or an icon. The root span forwards native attributes. Without a photo or after a load failure, Avatar shows supplied fallback content, then the first character of alt, then a decorative profile icon.

srcSet.description: Native responsive image candidates (passed to srcset).

sizes.description: Native responsive image size hints for srcSet.

alt.description: Name the image or automatic initial when it conveys information; leave empty beside redundant text.

content: Default slot: optional initials or icon. A small client script reveals the fallback on an image error; no framework island is needed.
events: No component events. Listen for native events on the rendered DOM if needed.

Badge.purpose: Attach a count, dot, or short label to inline content, or show it on its own. Give an interactive child an accessible name that includes the meaning of the badge (e.g. 120 unread messages). Native attributes pass to the wrapper.

badgeContent.description: Scalar standard badge label. Empty strings are hidden. Number labels above max display max followed by '+'; string labels are not capped.

color.description: Clay defaults to primary rather than MUI's default color.

showZero.description: Show a zero label in the standard variant.

invisible.description: Hide the indicator; keep the wrapped content visible.

variant.description: A dot does not need a label.

anchorOrigin.description: Corner of the wrapped content to anchor to. Ignored without wrapped content.

overlap.description: Use circular to inset the indicator for a rounded target such as Avatar.

content: Default slot: content the badge is attached to.
badge-content: optional inline markup instead of the scalar badgeContent in the standard variant.
events: No component events or client script.

CircularProgress.purpose: Render a circular progressbar. Use determinate when progress can be measured; otherwise omit a value. Native SVG attributes pass to the root, except the controlled viewBox and progress state.

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the operation being measured.

min.description: Minimum on the determinate scale. A nonfinite or nonincreasing scale falls back to 0–100.

value.description: Determinate value, clamped to the min–max interval. Defaults to min.

size.description: Diameter in CSS pixels or a CSS length string.

thickness.description: Stroke width in SVG units. Numeric size uses a matching viewBox; lengths use a 40-unit viewBox.

disableShrink.description: Keep the rotating arc at a fixed length when indeterminate.

enableTrackSlot.description: Show the underlying ring. Clay keeps it visible by default.

events: No component events or client script.

LinearProgress.purpose: Render a horizontal progressbar. Use determinate for measured tasks, buffer for a measure and its buffered amount, or indeterminate or query for a wait without a known amount. Native div attributes pass to the root except the controlled progress state.

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the operation being measured.

min.description: Minimum of the determinate or buffered scale. A nonfinite or nonincreasing scale falls back to 0–100.

max.description: Maximum of the determinate or buffered scale.

value.description: Completed amount in the determinate and buffer variants. Clamped to the min–max interval; defaults to min.

valueBuffer.description: Buffered amount in the buffer variant. Clamped between the completed amount and max; defaults to the completed amount.

events: No component events or client script.

Skeleton.purpose: Show a decorative placeholder while content loads. Hidden from assistive technology; if needed describe loading on the surrounding region, not the Skeleton. Native attributes pass to the root span.

width.description: Width in CSS pixels or a CSS length string. A circle mirrors the other side if omitted and defaults to 40px when both sides are omitted.

height.description: Height in CSS pixels or a CSS length string. A circle mirrors the other side if omitted and defaults to 40px when both sides are omitted.

animation.description: Animation style; use false for a static placeholder. Respects reduced-motion preferences.

events: No component events or client script.

Table.purpose: Lay out hand-written native HTML table markup inside a keyboard-focusable scrolling region. Use scope on row and column headers where appropriate. Native root attributes such as class and style target the scrolling wrapper. For rows and columns as data, with sorting, search, pagination and selection, use DataTable.

label.description: Required accessible name of the scroll region (Clay addition).

size.description: Controls cell spacing and font size.

padding.description: Use size-based cell padding, no padding, or compact padding suitable for checkboxes.

stickyHeader.description: Pin the native thead while the wrapper scrolls. Set max-height on the wrapper to enable vertical scrolling.

content: Default slot: native table content, e.g. caption, thead, tbody, and tfoot.
events: No component events or client script.

DataTable.purpose: Data-driven table: pass rows and columns; it renders a Table with optional sorting, quick filter search, pagination, checkbox selection and clickable rows. MUI DataGrid naming. Clay deviations: columns may be field-name strings and default to the first row's keys; row ids are strings; renderCell is a Svelte snippet or, in Astro, a function returning markup written inline in the template. For hand-written markup use Table.

label.description: Required accessible name of the scrolling table region (Clay addition).

rows.description: Row objects. In server pagination mode, only the current page.

type.description: number aligns right and sorts numerically; actions is neither sortable nor searchable.

filterable.description: Searched by the quick filter. Default true, false for actions.

valueGetter.description: (value, row) => unknown: derive the cell value; sorting uses it.

valueFormatter.description: (value, row) => string: displayed and searched text.

renderCell.description: Custom cell content from (params: { row, id, field, value, formattedValue, rowIndex }). Svelte: a snippet. Astro: a function returning markup, written inline in the template.

columns.description: Column definitions; default: the keys of the first row.

getRowId.description: (row) => string | number. Default: row.id, then the row position.

rowHeader.description: Field rendered as the row header (th scope=row); default: the first non-action column. With clickable rows it is the keyboard button.

checkboxSelection.description: Add a checkbox column, a select-all checkbox over the filtered rows, and a selected count.

rowSelectionModel.description: Selected row ids. Svelte: supports bind:rowSelectionModel.

sortModel.description: Active sort; header clicks cycle ascending, descending, unsorted. Svelte: supports bind:sortModel.

quickFilter.description: Show a search field that keeps rows containing every typed word in a filterable column; typing returns to the first page.

paginationModel.description: Zero-based page and page size. Svelte: supports bind:paginationModel.

sortingMode.description: server: rows arrive sorted; the table only reports sortModel changes.

filterMode.description: server: rows arrive filtered; the table only reports quickFilterValue changes.

paginationMode.description: server: rows is the current page and rowCount is required.

loading.description: Show a progress bar and mark the region busy.

stickyHeader.description: Pin the header while the region scrolls; set max-height on the table region via CSS.

localeText.description: Optional overrides for the table's rendered UI strings.

clickableRows.description: Rows fire clay-row-click; the row header becomes the keyboard button. Clicks on links, buttons and inputs inside a row keep their own behavior.

content: toolbar: optional named slot before the quick filter, e.g. bulk action buttons.
no-rows: optional named slot shown when rows is empty.
events: The server renders every row; the page script sorts, filters, pages and selects them. All events bubble from the root; detail is keyed by the prop name.
clay-row-click: detail { id, rowIndex } (rowIndex is the position in rows). Requires clickableRows.

<script lang="ts">
  import type { DataTableCellParams } from "@claymo/core/display";

  type Order = {
    id: string;
    customer: string;
    total: number | null;
    paid: boolean;

examples.title: Selection with a bulk action
examples.source:
<script lang="ts">
  let rows = $state([
    { id: "f1", name: "budget.xlsx", owner: "Ada", size: 24 },
    { id: "f2", name: "logo.svg", owner: "Grace", size: 8 },
    { id: "f3", name: "notes.md", owner: "Alan", size: 2 },
  ]);
  let selected = $state<string[]>([]);

  function remove() {
    // Send `selected` to your API; here the rows simply disappear.
    rows = rows.filter((row) => !selected.includes(row.id));
    selected = [];
  }
</script>

<DataTable
  label="Files"
  {rows}
  columns={[
    { field: "name", headerName: "Name" },
    { field: "owner", headerName: "Owner" },
    { field: "size", headerName: "Size (KB)", type: "number" },
  ]}
  checkboxSelection
  bind:rowSelectionModel={selected}
>
  {#snippet toolbar()}
    <Button variant="outlined" color="error" disabled={selected.length === 0} onclick={remove}>
      Delete selected
    </Button>
  {/snippet}
</DataTable>

examples.title: Edit rows in a dialog
examples.source:
<script lang="ts">
  import type { DataTableCellParams } from "@claymo/core/display";

  type Contact = { id: number; name: string; email: string };
  let rows = $state<Contact[]>([
    { id: 1, name: "Ada Byron", email: "ada@example.com" },
    { id: 2, name: "Grace Hopper", email: "grace@example.com" },
  ]);
  let editing = $state<Contact>();
  let draft = $state({ name: "", email: "" });
  let open = $state(false);
  const dirty = $derived(
    !!editing && (draft.name !== editing.name || draft.email !== editing.email),
  );

  function edit(row: Contact) {
    editing = row;
    draft = { name: row.name, email: row.email };
    open = true;
  }
  function save(event: SubmitEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    rows = rows.map((row) => (row.id === editing?.id ? { ...row, ...draft } : row));
    open = false;
  }
  // Escape and backdrop clicks ask first when there are unsaved edits.
  function requestClose() {
    if (!dirty || confirm("Discard unsaved changes?")) open = false;
  }
</script>

{#snippet editButton({ row }: DataTableCellParams<Contact>)}
  <IconButton size="small" aria-label="Edit {row.name}" onclick={() => edit(row)}>
    <svg
      aria-hidden="true"
      width="18"
      height="18"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 20h4L19 9l-4-4L4 16v4Z" /></svg
    >
  </IconButton>
{/snippet}

<DataTable
  label="Contacts"
  {rows}
  columns={[
    { field: "name", headerName: "Name" },
    { field: "email", headerName: "Email" },
    { field: "edit", type: "actions", renderCell: editButton },
  ]}
/>
<Dialog bind:open title="Edit contact" onClose={requestClose}>
  <form id="contact-form" class="contact-form" onsubmit={save}>
    <TextField label="Name" bind:value={draft.name} fullWidth />
    <TextField label="Email" type="email" bind:value={draft.email} fullWidth />
  </form>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Button variant="text" onclick={() => (open = false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button type="submit" form="contact-form" disabled={!dirty}>Save</Button>
  {/snippet}
</Dialog>

<style>
  .contact-form {
    display: grid;
    gap: 16px;
    padding-block-start: 8px;
  }
</style>

examples.title: Server-side data with loading state
examples.source:
<script lang="ts">
  import type { DataTablePaginationModel, DataTableSortModel } from "@claymo/core/display";

  type Book = { id: number; title: string; year: number };
  const library: Book[] = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, index) => ({
    id: index + 1,
    title: `Volume ${index + 1}`,
    year: 1990 + ((index * 7) % 30),
  }));

  // Stands in for your API: it filters, sorts and pages, and reports the total.
  async function fetchBooks(
    page: DataTablePaginationModel,
    sort: DataTableSortModel,
    search: string,
  ) {
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    const found = library.filter((book) => book.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
    const [order] = sort;
    if (order) {
      const direction = order.sort === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
      found.sort(
        (a, b) =>
          direction *
          (order.field === "year"
            ? a.year - b.year
            : a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "en", { numeric: true })),
      );
    }
    return {
      rows: found.slice(page.page * page.pageSize, (page.page + 1) * page.pageSize),
      total: found.length,
    };
  }

  let paginationModel = $state({ page: 0, pageSize: 5 });
  let sortModel = $state<DataTableSortModel>([]);
  let quickFilterValue = $state("");
  let rows = $state<Book[]>([]);
  let rowCount = $state(0);
  let loading = $state(true);

  $effect(() => {
    const request = fetchBooks(paginationModel, sortModel, quickFilterValue);
    let current = true;
    loading = true;
    request.then((result) => {
      if (!current) return; // a newer request replaced this one
      rows = result.rows;
      rowCount = result.total;
      loading = false;
    });
    return () => (current = false);
  });
</script>

<DataTable
  label="Books"
  {rows}
  {rowCount}
  {loading}
  columns={[
    { field: "title", headerName: "Title" },
    { field: "year", headerName: "Year", type: "number" },
  ]}
  quickFilter
  pagination
  pageSizeOptions={[5, 10]}
  paginationMode="server"
  sortingMode="server"
  filterMode="server"
  bind:paginationModel
  bind:sortModel
  bind:quickFilterValue
>
  {#snippet noRows()}No books match.{/snippet}
</DataTable>
